summary.text: Matthew Brooks is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A lifelong Sandown resident and recent University of New Hampshire graduate, Brooks said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include accessibility to constituents, infrastructure, and opposing any new taxes.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Brooks graduated from Timberlane Regional High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Brooks said he majored in political science with minors in justice studies and forensic science and is an active member of the Sandown Republican Committee.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a political operative.
Brooks and Kevin Major defeated incumbent Donald Selby in the Republican primary for Rockingham 9 on September 8, 2026.
In the survey, Brooks said he would be accessible to constituents, work to improve infrastructure such as roads, bridges and power lines, and oppose new taxes, including a state income tax.
He listed infrastructure, school choice and education reform, and constitutional rights as the policy areas he is passionate about.
